notes.title: Now Available on Steam - Cowbots and Aliens
notes.content:
Cowbots and Aliens is Now Available on Steam!

Cowbots and Aliens is a furious PvP Multiplayer VR brawl set in the Saloon-iverse! Free movement, laser precise gunplay, multiple competitive modes and a custom networked physics system that lets you use EVERYTHING as a weapon makes for an immensely satisfying VR ruckus!

notes.title: New Starting Area
notes.content:

 Let us know what you think! :)

notes.title: Update: New Weapon - The Rifle!
notes.content:
[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/26215558/986e03dbd714ac07482731d7f0ec339fe03e2b86.png[/img]
Today we pushed out an update that introduces a new gun to the game. We also added the ability to hold the shotgun and the rifle with two hands.

Rifle Features:
 - Heavy damage with a slower fire rate.
 - Can be held with two hands giving better stability for long shots.
 - Melee bonus when hitting with the butt of the gun.

Have fun and as always let us know if you run into any bugs or have any suggestions.

Happy Shootin!

notes.title: Big Update! 8 New Maps!

notes.title: The Scumbots are coming! (Single Player on it's way)
notes.content:
[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/26215558/0dd48ec0e289519b4d1080c44630f8d255be61b3.png[/img]

Hey everybody!

 Since launching Cowbots and Aliens in November our small team has been working tirelessly to address the glaring problem that there is nothing to do in game when no one else is around. Rest assured the solution is well on it's way!

Cowbots and Aliens is getting BOTS! Soon you will be able to battle in your favourite game mode along side and against enemy AIs.

We also have plans for a CO-OP wave mode featuring the dreaded Scumbots!

Also in the works are several new levels which will be added to the existing game modes allowing players to cycle through different locations making for more varied experiences. 

 These new features will be rolled out in a series of updates over the next several weeks. The first of these updates will introduce our new BOT AI and be available before Christmas. Keep an eye out!

 Thanks for your suggestions and patience as we develop Cowbots and Aliens through it's Early Access phase.

notes.title: Single Player Content and Scheduled Play Time
notes.content:
Hi All,

 We are well aware that it's proving difficult to find people to play with sometimes in these early days of Early Access. Alas, Cowbots and Aliens did not go viral and amass a huge fan base right off the bat. With that said we really believe in the game's potential and will continue to put all our effort into improving upon it.

SO - here are some things we intend to do:

Single Player Content. 
We are working on some content that will make Cowbots and Aliens more fun to hang out in solo. As players spend more time in game engaging with the single player content it will provide more opportunities for players to run into each other and get fun multiplayer games going as well.

Scheduled Play Sessions. We are going to start scheduling regular play sessions via [url=http://vrlfg.net/]http://vrlfg.net/[/url]. (Scroll to the bottom of the page to see scheduled play sessions.) Please add your own play session times and we will hope to be able to make it. Note that the time zone is GMT for the vrlfg.net scheduler.

Our first scheduled play session is tomorrow Wed, Nov 16th at 11:30pm GMT. (That's 3:30pm PST.) We will be giving out a free Steam Key for our other VR game Hoops VR for the winner of one of the matches. :D

Please comment and let us know if you like this idea or if you have any other thoughts on encouraging the growth and participation of Cowbots and Aliens player base.

notes.title: Cowbots and Aliens Hotfix 1
notes.content:
Yesterday we sent out an update that addresses some issues around physics objects sometimes becoming de-synchronized across the network. Some users had experienced objects disappearing from their hands. This issue should be solved. With that said, please keep an eye open for anything that looks like strange behaviour for the physics objects. Our networked physics is a huge part of what we're proud of in Cowbots and Aliens but is a complex system and will likely reveal more bugs to be squashed. Your assistance and patience is appreciated! :)

We also made some visual tweaks to the carts and gold bricks in Gold Rush mode in effort to make the objective more clear.

We are loving iterating on this game and seeing user feedback. Lots of fixes and new content on it's way!
